name: Classic Roasted Chicken
ingredients: ["2 lbs Chicken Fillets", "2 onions Onions", "4 potatoes Potatoes", "4 cloves Garlic", "2 tbsp Olive Oil", "1/2 tsp Thyme", "to taste Salt", "to taste Black Pepper"]
fiber: ["Preheat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken dry and season generously with salt, pepper, and thyme.", "Peel and quarter potatoes. Slice onions and mince garlic.", "Place chicken in a roasting pan. name: Chicken Stir-Fry
